facts.F1: Story #6361 S03c Package Forecasting, nwdes feature C of three (cycle and rules). First, a public examine command shows forecasts being recomputed after a Team refresh and the start-up forecast seeding firing, on demo data, so the examiner can observe the moved triggers, updater and seeder working. Then break the Flow metrics to Forecasting cycle by inverting Flow metrics' three edges through ports Flow metrics owns (IThroughputFilter, IForecastDataSufficiency, IHowManyForecaster), answered by Forecasting; Forecasting keeps depending on Flow metrics. Give Forecasting its own module rules (types in their layer, Domain reaches only the kernel, outside reaches Domain, Adapters and Application only from the lists, Application outbound) with inline lists, take the Forecasting entries off Flow metrics' inbound list and empty its Forecasting outbound list, and make the shared rule wording a parameter. Move Forecasting's unit tests to Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Modules/Forecasting with a placement test. Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, responses, metrics answers, forecast results, handler order, DI lifetimes and the schema stay the same. Design: docs/feature/story-6361-s03c-package-forecasting/feature-delta.md (slices C1-C3, D-3, D-6, D-9, Ratchet design R-F1..R-F6, Notes from the feature B reviews).

facts.F77: Run the public examine command forecast-triggers-show (declared in .nwave/examine.json, written into Scripts/examine/bin by build-examine-commands from the committed driver Scripts/examine/forecast-triggers-show.cs). It starts the checkout's backend in-process on a fresh SQLite database, loads one demo scenario through POST /api/v1/demo/scenarios/{id}/load, waits until GET /api/v1/update/status is idle, and reads GET /api/v1/systeminfo/refreshlog. (1) Team refresh: it picks a Team that serves at least one Portfolio, records the time, sends POST /api/v1/teams/{teamId}, waits until idle and reads the refresh log again. (2) Start-up seeding: it asks one Portfolio's forecast again with unchanged data (POST /api/v1/portfolios/refresh-all or the Team refresh again) and reads that round's Skipped flag, then disposes the host, starts a new host on the same database file, triggers the same round and reads the refresh log.
facts.F78: One line per observation and a last VERDICT line; exit 0 and OBSERVED only when (1) after the Team refresh the log holds a Forecast row (Type Forecast) for every Portfolio the Team serves with ExecutedAt later than the refresh request, and (2) the round on unchanged data before the restart is Skipped=true while the first round after the restart is Skipped=false, because the seeder forgot the stored forecast inputs at start. Each line names the Team, Portfolio ids and ExecutedAt values it read. A timeout or a missing row prints NOT OBSERVED with what was missing, why it matters and how to rerun, and exits non-zero.
